shared_elements: animal form (quadruped/creature) rendered in profile-like orientation
a head with eye and snout at one end of a body
justification: Both surfaces present some kind of animal with a distinguishable head and eye, but that is a generic correspondence that any tradition could produce independently. A shows a single massive rounded form carved in three dimensions with smooth modelled muzzle and brow, while B shows several repeated flat, angular creatures with zigzag bodies, spiky comb-like projections and dot-in-circle eyes covering the whole field — utterly different conventions, numbers of figures and arrangement.
